name: actus
label: ACTUS (Financial Contracts)

table_notes.actus_counterparty: Legal entity or natural person on the other side of a financial contract, identified by LEI and rated by credit quality.
table_notes.actus_contract: Core ACTUS contract record capturing contract type, terms, and the complete parameter set needed for cash flow simulation.
table_notes.actus_contract_event: Time-ordered sequence of cash flow events produced by the ACTUS algorithmic simulation engine for a given contract.
table_notes.actus_risk_factor: Market risk factors (interest rate curves, FX rates, credit spreads) referenced by ACTUS simulation algorithms.

actus_counterparty.name: id
actus_counterparty.description: Surrogate primary key for the counterparty record

actus_counterparty.name: lei
actus_counterparty.description: Legal Entity Identifier (ISO 17442) — globally unique 20-character code for the legal entity

actus_counterparty.name: name
actus_counterparty.description: Full legal name of the counterparty entity or individual

actus_counterparty.name: counterparty_type
actus_counterparty.description: Classification of counterparty role (e.g. bank, corporate, sovereign, central_bank)

actus_counterparty.name: country
actus_counterparty.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the counterparty's domicile

actus_counterparty.name: credit_rating
actus_counterparty.description: External credit rating (e.g. AAA, BB+) from a recognised ratings agency

actus_counterparty.name: default_probability
actus_counterparty.description: Annualised probability of default used in credit risk calculations (0.0–1.0)

actus_contract.name: id
actus_contract.description: Surrogate primary key for the contract record

actus_contract.name: contract_id
actus_contract.description: Business-level contract identifier (e.g. from originating system or LEI-based scheme)

actus_contract.name: contract_type
actus_contract.description: ACTUS contract type code (e.g. PAM=principal at maturity, ANN=annuity, CLM=call money)

actus_contract.name: contract_role
actus_contract.description: ACTUS contract role (RPA=receive principal, RPL=pay principal) — determines cash flow direction

actus_contract.name: counterparty_id
actus_contract.description: References the counterparty entity in actus_counterparty

actus_contract.name: settlement_currency
actus_contract.description: ISO 4217 currency code in which contractual cash flows are settled

actus_contract.name: notional_principal
actus_contract.description: Face value of the contract used as the basis for interest and cash flow calculations

actus_contract.name: nominal_interest_rate
actus_contract.description: Contractual interest rate expressed as a decimal (e.g. 0.05 = 5% p.a.)

actus_contract.name: day_count_convention
actus_contract.description: ACTUS day-count convention code (e.g. A360, A365, 30E360) governing accrual calculations

actus_contract.name: initial_exchange_date
actus_contract.description: Date of the first exchange of principal — marks the start of the contract

actus_contract.name: maturity_date
actus_contract.description: Scheduled end date of the contract when final principal repayment occurs

actus_contract.name: contract_terms
actus_contract.description: Full ACTUS attribute set for the contract type; keys follow ACTUS data dictionary

actus_contract.name: created_at
actus_contract.description: Timestamp when this contract record was inserted

actus_contract_event.name: id
actus_contract_event.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for the event row

actus_contract_event.name: contract_id
actus_contract_event.description: References the parent contract in actus_contract

actus_contract_event.name: scheduled_time
actus_contract_event.description: Exact timestamp at which this cash flow event is scheduled to occur

actus_contract_event.name: event_type
actus_contract_event.description: ACTUS event type code (e.g. IED=initial exchange, IP=interest payment, PR=redemption, MD=maturity)

actus_contract_event.name: payoff
actus_contract_event.description: Net cash flow amount for this event; positive = inflow to holder, negative = outflow

actus_contract_event.name: currency
actus_contract_event.description: ISO 4217 currency code in which the payoff is denominated

actus_contract_event.name: state_after
actus_contract_event.description: ACTUS contract state snapshot after this event (e.g. nominalValue, accruedInterest, statusDate)

actus_risk_factor.name: id
actus_risk_factor.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for the risk factor row

actus_risk_factor.name: market_object_code
actus_risk_factor.description: ACTUS market object code identifying this risk factor (e.g. LIBOR_3M, EUR/USD, EURIBOR_6M)

actus_risk_factor.name: risk_factor_type
actus_risk_factor.description: Category of market risk: INTEREST_RATE, EXCHANGE_RATE, CREDIT_SPREAD, or EQUITY_PRICE

actus_risk_factor.name: currency
actus_risk_factor.description: ISO 4217 currency code for this risk factor (base currency for FX, denomination for rates)

actus_risk_factor.name: base_value
actus_risk_factor.description: Current or reference value of the risk factor used as the simulation baseline

long_description: ACTUS (Algorithmic Contract Types Unified Standards) provides mathematically precise definitions for all financial contract types — from simple loans (PAM) to complex derivatives. Unlike accounting-focused schemas, ACTUS captures the complete cash flow algorithm for each contract type, enabling deterministic simulation of future cash flows under any market scenario. Widely adopted for stress testing and IRRBB compliance.
when_to_use: Use for fintech applications modeling loan portfolios, bond analytics, derivative pricing, or regulatory stress testing. EU Solvency II and Basel IV implementations benefit from ACTUS-aligned data models. Essential for any system that needs to calculate future cash flows algorithmically rather than storing static schedules.
